brief: Prepare a complaint with a clear requested remedy and supporting transaction evidence.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Clear Complaints"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Presenta una queja clara"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Faça uma reclamação clara"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Prepare a complaint with a clear requested remedy and supporting transaction evidence.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A complaint is easier to assess when it connects the disputed transaction, evidence and requested correction.
instruction.misconception: Anger alone or an unrelated document states a clear complaint, or a request guarantees the remedy.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: State what happened, identify the transaction, attach relevant evidence and request a specific correction. Keep a copy and reference number.
The request identifies the disputed error and desired correction.
The receipt and entries connect the claim to the transaction.
Specific transaction details help locate the disputed event.
These records support tracking and any later escalation.
A requested remedy is not yet a confirmed outcome.
The complete complaint connects the discrepancy, evidence and requested review.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
